_comment_displayName: Preset name shown in the pitch panel.
_comment_pitcherThrowsLeftHanded: Pitcher throws with the left hand when true; right hand when false.
_comment_initialSpeedMetersPerSecond: Initial speed [m/s], direction fixed toward home plate.
_comment_releaseHeightMeters: Pitch release height [m] before mound offset.
_comment_spinAxisX: Spin axis vector X component; (-1,0,0) is pure backspin.
_comment_dragCoefficient: Fixed drag factor k = rho*A*C_D/(2m) [1/m] at 1.225 kg/m^3 (drag acceleration = k*v^2); a real baseball is about 0.0066. Ignored when useCoefficientTable is true.
_comment_liftCoefficient: Fixed Magnus factor [1/s] (acceleration = factor*v*(rpm/3000)*sin(angle between spin axis and velocity)). Ignored when useCoefficientTable is true.
_comment_useCoefficientTable: Use speed/spin-dependent physical drag and Magnus coefficients (Nathan 2017 fits) instead of the fixed factors.
_comment_environmentSettingsFile: Referenced environment settings JSON file name.
_comment_activePitchProfileIndex: Selected pitch profile index when random selection is disabled.
_comment_randomPitchProfileEnabled: If true, choose pitch profile randomly.
_comment_pitchProfiles: Array of pitch profiles and their pitch parameters.
